resources.string: Connect the app to your site. On this phone, open Noxpress → Live Operator in your site\'s admin and tap «Connect the app», or type the site\'s address. The site needs the Live Operator plugin.
Type the site\'s address, e.g. example.com (https only).
Connect to %1$s? Check the address and tap Connect.
The link does not hold a valid https address. Type the site\'s address.
Connected to %1$s. Type another address to change it.
%1$s does not list this app yet (Live Operator 1.4.0+ does it by itself). The app will work with an address bar at the top.
Could not reach %1$s. Check the address and the connection, and try again.
Tap to download the signed APK.
